help.emergencyText: If you feel unwell or think you took the wrong medicine, call 112 or go to your nearest hospital. DoseSaathi cannot help in an emergency.
help.faq1A: Yes — your saved schedule and dose recording work offline. Caregiver alerts and syncing need an internet connection.
help.faq2A: No. Caregivers can only view your doses and adherence. Only you can change your medicines.
help.faq2Q: Can my caregiver change my medicines?
help.faq3A: Their access ends immediately. They can no longer see your medicines or receive alerts.
help.faq3Q: What happens when I remove a caregiver?
help.faq4A: Only with the people you explicitly invite, and only what they need to see. Nothing is sold.
help.faq4Q: Is my data shared with anyone?
help.missedDoseText: Follow the instructions on your prescription, or contact your doctor or pharmacist for advice. Do not double a dose or take a missed dose late unless your doctor tells you to.
help.missedDoseTitle: What if I miss a dose?
help.safetyText: DoseSaathi helps you follow your prescription. It does not diagnose, recommend medicines, or change doses. If a medicine, dose, or instruction is unclear, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
help.step1Text: Go to Medicines, tap “Add a medicine”, and copy the details from your prescription. Review them before saving.
help.step2Text: Your dashboard shows the next dose. When it is due, tap “Mark as taken”.
help.step3Text: In Caregiver, invite a trusted person. They are alerted only if a dose stays unconfirmed past your grace period.
help.step4Text: If the internet drops, you can still view your schedule and record doses. Changes sync when you are back online.
help.subtitle: How DoseSaathi works, and what to do if something is unclear.
help.supportSent: Thank you. Your message has been recorded and our team will follow up.
help.title: Help & safety

landing.feature2Text: In-app reminders when a dose is due, with snooze when life gets in the way.
landing.feature3Text: A trusted family member is alerted only if a dose stays unconfirmed — with your permission.
landing.feature4Text: View your schedule and record doses without internet. Changes sync when you are back online.
landing.heroSubtitle: DoseSaathi helps you and your family follow your prescribed medicines — with clear reminders, a simple daily schedule, and a caregiver who is kept in the loop.
landing.heroTitle: Never miss a dose. Never feel alone.
landing.safetyText: DoseSaathi is an adherence and care-coordination tool. It never diagnoses, never recommends a medicine, and never changes your prescription. Always follow your doctor or pharmacist.
landing.step1: Add your medicines exactly as written on your prescription.
landing.step2: See your daily schedule and get reminded when a dose is due.
landing.step3: Tap “Mark as taken”. Your caregiver is alerted only if a dose is missed.
